action.description: extract_profile reads a standard document and writes a requirement profile (needs a connected model). validate_profile checks a profile JSON, generated or hand-written, with no model call.

artifact_id.description: Artifact id of the standard document (PDF or text) for extract_profile, or of the profile JSON for validate_profile.

file_path.description: Path to the same file, as an alternative to artifact_id.

thinking_level.description: Reasoning depth requested for the read. Higher is slower.

force_text.description: Skip native PDF ingestion and send locally extracted text instead.
